title: fix(sdk): preserve string-valued gateway error messages
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: The shared SDK response parser now preserves string-valued gateway error messages instead of replacing them with generic HTTP-status messages. Explicit message precedence, nested error parsing, HTTP status, and error metadata remain intact. An account earnings regression test uses the gateway’s actual failure response. The SDK prerelease version, standalone lockfile, and changelog were updated. Found, fixed, and verified by Ribbert, an automated bug hunter.
